high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified account "alessandro_michele." The post features a close-up of a highly embellished outfit, predominantly silver with intricate details. The fabric appears to be covered in sparkling rhinestones or sequins, giving it a glittering and luxurious look. The word "LUCCICANZA" is prominently displayed on the garment in bold, black letters, which translates to "sparkle" in Italian. The outfit includes a jacket and gloves, both adorned with the same sparkling material.
